summary:
ORB fixed opening-high resting paper model, RE-PIN after a required rebase. Base 91ed8c59 is the current origin/main tip after #913, #914 and #916 merged; strict branch protection forced the rebase and no conflict occurred.

REBASE IDENTITY VERIFIED INDEPENDENTLY, not accepted from the author. I computed both diff hashes myself:
  old  1e685ede..e63dbfed  sha256 = 01f3867508b2853084bc19076be9f30da9a558237ae27f0d15768a22391ff192
  new  91ed8c59..83809890  sha256 = 01f3867508b2853084bc19076be9f30da9a558237ae27f0d15768a22391ff192
BYTE-IDENTICAL, and equal to codex-2's stated value. Base is the main tip AND is an ancestor of the head, so the audit can grade it (the strict-mode requirement). 2 commits, each exactly one OpenAI Codex marker, reviewer differs from every author.

LEDGER HYGIENE CHECKED BEFORE PINNING, because the gate globs records/*/pr-<N>--*.json across EVERY head directory and a record naming an unreachable commit fails the whole PR. `git ls-tree -r origin/review-pins | grep pr-915--` returns NOTHING, and the superseded e63dbfed record is confirmed absent from the current view. This is the #904 poisoning trap and it is clear.

RE-PROVEN ON THIS EXACT TREE rather than carried across the rebase, because the base moved even though the diff did not:
  focused ORB/service/isolation suite: 41 passed.
  MUT-1 drop first_post_close_quote  -> test_adjustment_refuses_price_evidence_from_before_the_0930_close RED. This is the finding I raised on the first head, where the same mutation left all 9 tests GREEN; it remains closed.
  MUT-2 drop market_below_new_level  -> the ORIGINAL test_unproven_adjustment_is_recorded_and_neither_left_nor_pulled RED. Both conjuncts of the adjustment gate stay independently covered.
  MUT-3 add a dynamic import to orb_app.py -> test_orb_modules_have_no_trade_intent_broker_or_dynamic_dispatch_path RED. ORB's structural isolation control still bites on this tree.
  Each mutant parse-checked before running, after a void run earlier today where a mutant would not load and its empty output proved nothing. Tree restored clean, 10/10.

THE SUBSTANTIVE REVIEW CARRIES from the e63dbfed pin because the diff is byte-identical: isolation re-proven from scratch on the new orb_app.py (unchanged import set, no importlib, three xadd targets none of which is the intents stream, and zero occurrences of TradeIntentEvent, trade_intents, oms_managed_positions, virtual_positions, BrokerAdapter, submit/cancel/replace_order, broker_adapters); decision_blocked genuinely consulted at the fill guard; the UNANSWERABLE branch fail-closed and refusing the operator's leave-or-pull choice; and a one-variable controlled pair of 46 failed/3316 passed against 46 failed/3326 passed with failure and error sets identical by name.

NOT COVERED, unchanged and none of it blocking:
(a) THIS IS A BEHAVIOUR CHANGE TO A RUNNING SERVICE. build_orb_paper_env.sh strips MAI_TAI_ORB_RUNNING_HIGH_ENABLED and MAI_TAI_ORB_RESTING_ENTRY_ENABLED from the source env and forces both TRUE. The box runs RESTING_ENTRY_ENABLED=false today on the running_high_breakout path pricing off the ask; after an isolated-env rebuild and an ORB restart it becomes the fixed resting model. Paper and broker-free, so no money moves, but it is the operator's decision and neither the rebuild nor the restart is in this PR.
(b) The leave-or-pull default is correctly ABSENT and must stay absent.
(c) UNEXERCISED: live-paper denominator 0, and it stays 0 until ORB is restarted onto this env.
A PIN IS NOT DEPLOY AUTHORIZATION and I am not proposing a restart.
